results.exact_after_text: The projected CAGR of 7.5% (2025-2032) takes market value to USD 86 Mn in 2032. Clinical episodes rise by approximately 26,900 over the forecast period, while implied clinical revenue per episode increases by about 21%. That combination places more emphasis on workup completion, appropriate test intensity and retained specialist interpretation than on new patient acquisition alone. A constant retail allocation prevents unsupported assumptions about home-testing displacement from driving the terminal result. Growth depends on affordability and clinical execution; insurance expansion, major new facilities and exceptional inbound patient inflows are not necessary assumptions in the base case.
